name: Mahindra All India Talent Scholarship (MAITS) for Diploma studies

rules.quote: Candidate should have passed SSC/HSC or equivalent examinations in the 10th /12th standard with more than 60% marks.

value: diploma at government/recognised polytechnic, first year or lateral entry
rules.quote: secured admission in the first year or direct admission into the second year (lateral admission) in a government or any other recognised Polytechnic Institute for diploma course.

rules.value: low yearly income (no figure on page)
rules.quote: The candidate should belong to a family with low yearly income.

amount.text: Rs 10,000 per annum for up to 3 years; 550 students a year
amount.quote: This Trust awards Rs. 10,000/- per annum to 550 students annually, for a maximum period of 3 years.

deadline.text: 2026-27: Gujarat 30 Sep 2026; Delhi and UP 4 Oct 2026; other states 10 Oct 2026; MH, TN, AP, TS already closed
deadline.quote: The last date to apply for the students from other states is 10th October 2026.
